## Hands-on 3 – Reproducing a recorded result {#hands-on-3-reproduce-the-recorded-result .smaller}

::: {.small}
- **Task 3**, in the browser lab or in the working script of the workspace: choose **C6HJR**, **KQXUE** or **018OL**
- In the browser lab each analyst has a few cells of its own, one step to a cell, with gaps to fill, hints and full solutions; in the working script the three are written out
- In the browser, one cell of 018OL installs two packages for mixed models, a download of about 32 MB
:::

::: {.fragment}
When you have your value, type the analyst and the *t* in the chat – `KQXUE t = -7.169` – and hold it until I say "go".
:::

::: notes
Now you work. Open Task 3, in the browser lab or, if you work in the workspace, in the working script, and choose one of the three analysts. In the browser lab each has a few cells of its own, one step to a cell, and every gap to fill has a hint and a fully worked solution underneath. Using the hints and the solutions is not cheating, because this task is about the number at the end rather than the typing. In the working script the three are written out, so read them line by line as you run them. If you choose 018OL in the browser, one of its cells downloads the packages for mixed models, so give it a minute. When you have your value, type the analyst and the t into the chat, but do not send. When I say go, everyone sends at once. If you finish early, take a second analyst. Twenty minutes. [wait for the numbers in the chat]
:::
